text.description_html:
Don-Jo CFK70-630, 3-1/2" x 15" Brushed Stainless Steel Push Plate with Hole

This 3-1/2" wide x 15" high commercial door push plate has a cylinder hole cut-out perfect for adding a lock or lever. The 3-1/2" x 15" Push Plate with Hole is primarily used in commercial applications such as in restaurants, warehouses, factories, and stores. Made of .050" thick high quality solid stainless steel for longevity. Packaged with stainless mounting screws for easy installation.

Also available: Matching 3-1/2" x 15" Pull Plate with Hole

This commercial push plate is made in the USA by Don-Jo Manufacturing.

Specifications of Don-Jo CFK70-630 Stainless Steel Push Plate:

  • Plate Height: 15"
  • Plate Width: 3-1/2"
  • Hole Diameter: 2-1/8"
  • Hole is 1-3/4" on center from edge of plate.
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Packaged with mounting screws.
  • Don-Jo CFK70-630 Dimensions (PDF)

*Sold Individually. Get a matching 3-1/2" x 15" Pull Plate with Cut-out
